args.name: header.json
args.section_json:
{
  "conventions": [
    "Every new .ts or .tsx source file must begin with the 2026 Apache-2.0 Backstage license header comment block.",
    "Format code with Prettier (@backstage/cli/config/prettier: single quotes, trailing commas, 2-space indentation).",
    "Use TypeScript strict typing; never use @ts-ignore or @ts-expect-error in production code.",
    "Normalise entity references with parseEntityRef and stringifyEntityRef from @backstage/catalog-model using en-US lowercase for kind and namespace.",
    "User-facing strings in @backstage/plugin-catalog and @backstage/plugin-techdocs must be defined in each plugin's translation ref and accessed via useTranslationRef.",
    "Never hand-edit generated OpenAPI files (src/schema/openapi/generated/**) or API reports (report*.api.md); regenerate them via tooling steps."
  ],
  "decisions": [
    {
      "topic": "Former-names annotation constant and value format",
      "choice": "Export ANNOTATION_FORMER_NAMES = 'backstage.io/former-names' from @backstage/catalog-model; value is a comma-separated list of entity refs where each trimmed entry defaults missing kind and namespace to the declaring entity's kind and namespace (or DEFAULT_NAMESPACE) and is validated in FieldFormatEntityPolicy.",
      "rejected": [
        "YAML array in metadata.annotations (annotations in Backstage entity descriptors are string-to-string maps)",
        "Separate spec.formerNames field (requires altering base Entity schema across all kinds instead of metadata annotations)"
      ],
      "reason": "Matches Backstage annotation conventions (annotations are string maps; comma-separated entity refs match existing multi-value annotations and parseEntityRef default context rules)."
    },
    {
      "topic": "Former-name indexing, conflict resolution, and database query performance",
      "choice": "During stitching in buildEntitySearch, skip the raw metadata.annotations.backstage.io/former-names traversal entry and emit one search row per n
